workflow_rules.initial-selection: for clear initial full work choose the smallest suitable fixed recipe and save rationale; explicit operator choices and stricter specialties win. ask only for material intent, scope, acceptance or authority ambiguity. selection grants no publication, merge, production or other external-action authority.
workflow_rules.method-switch: v1 later selections require operator approval. only new opted-in v2 report tasks may switch once between research and read-only investigate with initial saved operator preauthorization and unchanged full question, scope, acceptance, access, authority and report contract. reconcile every prior owner stopped and resolve every active, blocked or uncertain intent first. no probes, implement, plan, publication, lightweight detour or repair-budget reset.
workflow_rules.review-reuse: v1 request/delivery revision changes require fresh verification. v2 reuse requires the latest actual passed verifier for the exact candidate, unchanged saved substantive implementation identity/base/check assumptions, no intervening worker and an explicit current comparison-evidence decision. current delivery authority, clean head, target/base, duplicate-pr, remote-head and required-ci gates remain; an old local receipt is not pr completion.
workflow_rules.state-ownership: tasks-axi owns lifecycle and concise discoverable material handoff; coordinator alone owns manifest decisions/intents/next action; each agent alone owns checkpoint progress. immutable briefs/reports retain exact request/authority/evidence. no routine step mirroring, link-only handoffs or timestamp-wins conflict resolution; full relevant recovery and full-body-before-update remain mandatory.
workflow_rules.final-gates: focused iteration never replaces canonical worker candidate make format and make test plus required task checks, or fresh independent exact-candidate gates. unavailable checks block. verifiers never repair product code; changed candidate requires fresh review. initial verification plus at most two repair rounds, with no method/replacement/acceptance detour reset.

routing_rules.lightweight-record: use tasks-axi lifecycle and existing task-local saved request/report files, not a new database, schema or helper. for brainstorming/docs save concise original request, acceptance, authority, lightweight opt-in, scope/resources/dependencies/promises, limits and actual outcome; link it in the task's discoverable handoff. for delegated research additionally save **before launch** assignment/predecessor, unique absolute tracker/helper/report/worktree (or null) paths, full filled brief, dispatch intent and recovery lookup. after launch record observed outcome/native ids (not inferred from missing tracker) and send later ids to the checkpoint owner. the scout owns its checkpoint and report. coordinator reads the actual report, records explicit review/delivery outcome and lifecycle; completed scout status alone does not finish the task. an unresolved launch intent remains a warning in task notes.
routing_rules.interrupted-intent: intent saved, launch response lost: missing checkpoint/native id does not prove nothing ran. block, inspect native state and real artifacts, reconcile all owners, then confirm the actual launch or authorize a stopped-owner replacement. never duplicate-dispatch merely because there is no manifest.
routing_rules.report-before-outcome: report written, coordinator outcome not saved: read the actual report and checkpoint, compare the saved request/authority, record explicit review/delivery outcome and update lifecycle. do not rerun the scout or infer success from completed status.
routing_rules.escalation: scout discovers a code/policy/probe need: stop at report boundary, preserve prior records and reconcile stopped ownership. save separately authorized full work and link earlier evidence; initialize a normal workflow without retroactive stage passes. no new access, authority or budget reset follows from escalation.
routing_rules.startup-broadening: broaden whenever summaries are ambiguous, links are missing, index information is insufficient, ownership is uncertain or global recovery requires it. use actual cli help before filters; no new tasks query api is assumed. existing poor summaries require broader reads until a normal material handoff improves them; no bulk rewrite. read the **full body before every update**, regardless of startup scope. fully reconcile each reused assignment/worktree from task, manifest, saved briefs, checkpoints, native state and actual artifacts, regardless of status. `worktree.py list` is registered inventory, not agent liveness. if a conflict emerges mid-work, pause affected actions and read/reconcile/record it before continuing.

routing_order: 1. unknown scope/authority/ownership blocks dispatch pending clarification/reconciliation.
2. explicit full recipe or specialty requirement uses the specified full recipe.

3. substantive code, config, dependencies, interfaces, operating policy, security, sensitive data, diagnostic execution, publication/merge/production or multiple agents/stages with unclear scope are excluded from lightweight handling.
4. certified reviewed spec/slice packages use plan v1 (refine/ground/validate/deliver).
5. small questions may be answered directly. opt-in brainstorming/critique answers are ideas with assumptions/limits, never grounded readiness or independent validation.
6. opt-in bounded one-scout read-only research may use the lightweight scout brief variant below. no diagnostic probes, source edits or publication.

7. opt-in mechanical/unambiguous non-policy docs may be done locally in an isolated worktree with saved request, authority, diff/check evidence and exact local commit/ outcome. canonical final project gates remain required. a tiny policy/security edit is substantive, not trivial. uncertain eligibility uses full implement.
8. otherwise select the smallest suitable full recipe with recorded rationale; clear initial selection needs no workflow-choice question, but grants no action authority.
routing_cases: bounded question; no action or unresolved ownership
opt-in ideas only; no certified package
reviewed product spec and slices requested
opt-in single bounded read-only question; known owner
opt-in unambiguous non-policy prose only; local commit
security guidance even without executable code
substantive safety review; no lightweight exemption
explicit probe authority and isolated worktree
explicit action authority and publication gates
otherwise lightweight research but operator selects research v1
otherwise trivial docs but pack requires full review
bounded delegated research without lightweight opt-in
missing old native id; checkpoint absent on resume
reconcile all potential writers before dispatch
unclear policy/security impact or multiple uncertain repos
startup_cases: clear indexed scope; no dependencies/resources/promises overlap
target depends on another repo/service/library task
material follow-up can affect request even across repos
alias or repo identity not resolved
missing links/poor index cannot exclude overlap
missing native identity or uncertain writer even across repos

capability_rules.preflight: before reserving an expensive attempt, inspect actual available harness/profile configuration and its tool allowlist. record profile/configuration source, observed allowed tools, authorized path writes, independence mode and limitations in the filled brief's capability_evidence. there is no portable introspection api, capabilities cli, probing service or runtime. use documented native facilities only. previous success is evidence, not a guarantee for a new session/profile.
capability_rules.capability-failure: post-launch tool/helper/test/report failure blocks required work: preserve last state and report redacted failure, reconcile native ownership and actual evidence before replacement. absent tracker is not proof no agent ran. do not suppress tracking/tests, self-approve, or launch again to compensate for missing tools. no compliant independent verifier means blocked delivery. no preflight grants network, production or publication authority. vendor-specific selection notes stay in `CLAUDE.md` (or that harness's instructions), not portable role contracts.

capability_roles: worktree reads/writes; shell/git/python/helper; required tests/formatter; task commit and assigned tracker/report writes
no publication, coordinator records or extra agents
fresh independent context; detached exact-head git/read/shell/test/formatter; authorized disposable probes/build outputs; python/helper and assigned tracker/report writes
no product repair, worker-tree edits, commit or publication
source/reference reads; python/helper execution; assigned tracker/report writes; fresh context for independent research/validation
null directory grants no other project commands; no source edits/probes
source/evidence reads; python/helper and assigned tracker/report writes; only explicitly authorized local diagnostic probes in supplied worktree
no production/shared mutation, fixes or expanded access
